text:
Zoe Kim: Heads-up: CloudMarket x EdgeIntegrate live lab at BeaconConf on 2024-07-09. Need final speaker lineup, demo failover, AV checklist, and customs-friendly swag list.
Ravi Menon: I'll run the multi-model failover demo (hardware primary, hosted Redwood fallback). Need 1 spare rig and SSH access.
Tanya Ortiz: Marketing: landing page + RSVP widget required. Recommend 350 live seats. Also need partner logo SVG + 2-sentence blurb by 2024-06-10.
Marco (CloudMarket): We can bring 3 rigs and 1 spare. Shipping ETA to venue 2024-07-03 if labels go out by 2024-06-20.
ops-bot: Created event: "EdgeIntegrate live lab dry run" on 2024-07-05 09:00 PT. Invited Zoe, Ravi, Tanya, Marco.
Zoe Kim: AV needs: 1x HDMI capture, wired ethernet, 1 presenter lapel mic, captions enabled. Also ensure arrival power strip + IEC extension.
Ravi Menon: Infra note: Add `deploy@redwood-demo` to authorized_keys and preseed healthcheck: `curl -fsS localhost:8080/health || echo FAIL`.
Tanya Ortiz: Swag: 400 sticker sheets, 120 charging cables (airline-friendly), 60 co-branded notebooks. No loose batteries. Deadline for customs docs = 2024-06-25.
Marco (CloudMarket): Confirmed - no batteries. I'll upload packing manifest + HS codes by 2024-06-18.
Zoe Kim: Run-of-show draft:
09:15 - Setup / sync
09:30 - Stream ON / Host intro (Zoe)
09:35 - Partner keynote (Marco)
09:45 - Demo: hw primary (Ravi) 
10:05 - Demo: hosted fallback + policy switch (Ravi)
10:20 - Live Q&A
10:35 - Close / CTA to marketplace tile
Ravi Menon: Suggest one short pre-recorded fallback clip (30s) in case hardware is delayed. I can record and upload by 2024-07-01.
Tanya Ortiz: Will create a short co-branded landing + short-link. Need final CTA copy from product by 2024-06-15.
Zoe Kim: Action list:
- Ravi: demo + fallback clip (due 2024-07-01)
- Marco: packing manifest + HS codes (due 2024-06-18)
- Tanya: landing + RSVP + swag plan (due 2024-06-25)
- Zoe: dry-run coordination + runbook (due 2024-07-05)
Marco (CloudMarket): On-site lead: Priya Shah (+1 650-555-0123). Will share contact and arrival ETA.
Zoe Kim: Legal/press embargo? Tanya please flag if press blurb needed.
Tanya Ortiz: Will loop legal if marketing blurb contains partner pricing or early access dates.
Zoe Kim: Thanks all — I'll update the shared sheet and ping reminders. :rocket:
